subject: Re: Dedicated/Private demo - timezone coordination + EU DPO / APAC security lead
messages:
From: Lukas Müller <lukas.muller@acme-retail.de>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@acme-retail.de>; Acme Retail Legal <legal@acme-retail.de>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 16:15:00 +01:00
Subject: Dedicated/Private demo request - EU & APAC security reviewers

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks for taking this — we're keen to see a Dedicated/Private demo focused on the EU-data residency and APAC compliance controls. Our EU DPO (Dr. Anna Schmidt) and APAC security lead (Sora Tanaka) need to join the call to validate controls and run a quick evidence check.

We have a few constraints to coordinate across timezones (and DST):
- Our primary users in Germany need morning CET slots (09:00-11:00 CET).
- APAC (Japan) prefers late afternoon JST (15:00-18:00 JST).
- Redwood's SE is in PDT — we've had DST shifts recently in the US, so please double-check local offsets.

Proposed slots (we tried to give cross-region overlap):
1) Tue Mar 24, 08:30 PDT / 16:30 CET / Wed Mar 25 00:30 JST (late for APAC)
2) Tue Mar 24, 11:00 PDT / 19:00 CET / Wed Mar 25 03:00 JST (too late for APAC)
3) Wed Mar 25, 15:00 CET / Wed 23:00 JST / 07:00 PDT (early for Redwood)

If none of those work, happy for you to propose a time. We'll need a 60-75 minute slot: 30-40 minute demo, 20-30 minute security Q&A.

I've attached a short agenda and a preliminary list of compliance items we expect to walk through (acme_security_checklist_v1.pdf).

Thanks,
Lukas
Head of Cloud Infrastructure
Acme Retail

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Müller <lukas.muller@acme-retail.de>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dr. Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@acme-retail.de>, Sora Tanaka <sora.tanaka@kimono.co.jp>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/Private demo request - EU & APAC security reviewers

Hi Lukas — thanks for the details and for flagging the timezone/DST complexities. We're excited to run this.

Quick notes:
- We'll aim for a 75-minute session so your reviewers have time to dig into evidence.
- Dylan will drive the demo; I'll drive coordination and follow-ups. Vivek (cc'd) will join for the compliance deep-dive and to ensure we bring the right artifacts.

To make scheduling practical, can you confirm:
- whether Anna needs morning CET strictly, or if 11:00-12:00 CET would be acceptable for her one-time meeting?
- whether Sora can shift 30-60 minutes earlier (14:00-16:00 JST) to meet more overlap with Europe?

Proposed new cross-region overlap slots (converted to your local times):
A) Wed Mar 24, 08:00 PDT / 16:00 CET / Thu Mar 25 00:00 JST — (works for EU morning, tight for APAC midnight)
B) Wed Mar 24, 10:30 PDT / 18:30 CET / Thu Mar 25 02:30 JST — (late for APAC)
C) Thu Mar 25, 07:00 PDT / 15:00 CET / Thu 23:00 JST — (late but within APAC evening window)

I attached a draft demo agenda (demo_agenda_2026-03-24.docx) and a short security checklist we typically use for Dedicated/Private reviews. Also attaching a calendar-invite stub once we lock the slot.

If you confirm Anna and Sora's soft preferences, I'll send a final calendar invite with dial-in + recording permissions.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: demo_agenda_2026-03-24.docx

Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/Private demo request - EU & APAC security reviewers

Thanks Marissa / Lukas — quick booking note from my side:
- Anna's team prefers a start between 09:00-11:00 CET; 11:00 CET is usually tolerable.
- Sora has indicated in past calls they can do a 30-60 minute shift earlier with advance notice (14:30-16:00 JST is feasible).

If Anna can stretch to 11:00 CET, that gives us an overlap with a late JST attendee at ~19:00 CET (but that's outside their preferred slots). My recommendation: propose two options to Anna & Sora and ask them to pick which of the two they can relax on.

Also: Dylan, can you confirm you have a short recording consent policy link and a live-demo scrub list (PI/data redaction) we can share with Acme before the call? Vivek, if you can confirm the exact artifacts (SOC 2, network diagram, retention policy) you'll need, that will speed the review.

Cheers,
Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sora Tanaka <sora.tanaka@kimono.co.jp>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lukas Müller <lukas.muller@acme-retail.de>
Cc: Dr. Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@acme-retail.de>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 02:10:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/Private demo request - EU & APAC security reviewers

Hi all — thanks for including APAC. I can shift earlier by ~60 minutes for this one (so 14:00-16:00 JST window is OK). For clarity on DST: our regional calendars align with JST (no DST), but please confirm the Redwood dial-in shows local times correctly — we ran into a mismatch on a previous call when US shifted in March.

For artifacts: APAC will need the network diagram + data flow for redaction checks; legal will want the retention policy. If you can share the recording policy and a quick list of what we'll see in the demo, that helps.

Looking at proposed slots, option C (Thu Mar 25, 23:00 JST) is OK for me if Anna is flexible. Otherwise, if Anna can do 11:00 CET, we can meet at ~19:00 CET which converts to 03:00 JST (not possible). So Anna's flexibility is the gating factor.

Best regards,
Sora Tanaka
Head of Security — Kimono Retail
